newsitem.title: BELGIUM: ITI HOLDINGS 1996 PROFIT UP 25 PERCENT.
newsitem.headline: ITI HOLDINGS 1996 PROFIT UP 25 PERCENT.

text.p: Luxembourg-listed Polish firm ITI Holdings SA, with multi-media interests and snacks in Poland, said consolidated net profit after minorities more than doubled to $7.8 million in 1996 from $3.3 million in 1995.
Consolidated sales rose to $80.4 million from $64.6 million.

The figures are preliminary. Audited statements and the annual report will be published in May after revised forecasts taking into account developments in the multiplex cinema joint venture Multikino and TV joint venture TVN/TV Wisla.
Provisional 1996 net profit was above company forecasts for a flat profit compared with 1995, while sales were above an expected $76.9 million.
ITI Holdings is the parent company of ITI Group which deals with advertising, theatrical and home video distribution, television broadcasting and snack food production.
The company, a partner of U.S.-based Central European Media Enterprises Ltd, has said it will seek a listing on the Warsaw stock exchange in 1998.
